description: Look up a website or URL (for example 'example-trade.com' or 'https://app.example-trade.com/login') in the official regulator warning lists compiled by Real Crypto Signals. Returns every matching warning with the regulator, country, date and official notice URL. An empty result does not mean the site is safe.

url.description: Website, domain or full URL to check.

name: check_website
title: Check a website against regulator warning lists
